ma.onAppShow(function callback)

Event of switching a Mini Program to the frontend. The callback parameters of this event are the same as those of App.onShow.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function for switching a Mini Program to the frontend.

Sample Code

let _this; 
let test1 = function () {
    console.log('aaa')
    _this.setData({
        detail: _this.data.detail + '\r\n' + 'onAppShow:ok',
    })
};

Page({
    onAppShow () {
        _this.setData({
            detail: _this.data.detail + '\r\n' + 'onAppShow',
        })
        ma.onAppShow(test1)
    }
})
